name: Simulation Result
definition: Output data from a circuit simulation run, including waveform data, operating points, and diagnostic messages

name: Transistor Operating Point
definition: DC bias conditions for a transistor including drain current, transconductance, threshold voltage, and region of operation
scope: PSF STRUCT/OP blocks from Spectre simulation

name: Transconductance
definition: Ratio of drain current change to gate voltage change (gm = dId/dVgs), a key figure of merit for analog transistors

name: gm/Id Ratio
definition: Transconductance efficiency metric (gm/Id), used for transistor sizing in weak/moderate inversion using the gm/Id methodology
scope: CMOS analog circuit design using gm/Id methodology

name: Overdrive Voltage
definition: Gate-source voltage minus threshold voltage (Vov = Vgs - Vth), determines transistor inversion level

name: Threshold Voltage
definition: Gate voltage at which transistor begins to conduct (Vth), extracted from simulation operating points

name: Virtuoso Session
definition: An active Virtuoso instance with a unique ID, port, and process identifier that can receive SKILL commands

name: SSH Tunnel
definition: An SSH port forwarding connection that enables vcli to communicate with a remote Virtuoso daemon
scope: Remote Virtuoso access via vcli tunnel

name: SKILL Result
definition: Response from a SKILL function call, containing status, output, errors, and execution metadata

name: Virtuoso Error
definition: An error condition from VirtuosoError enum, with type, exit code, retryable flag, and suggestion

name: Maestro ADE Session
definition: An ADE (Analog Design Environment) session managed through Maestro, containing setups, variables, and analyses

name: Schematic Cellview
definition: A Virtuoso schematic view containing instances, nets, and parameters for a circuit design

name: PSF Data
definition: Spectre simulation output format containing waveform data and operating points

name: Corner Analysis
definition: A multi-corner simulation that sweeps model parameters across process, voltage, and temperature variations

name: Transient Response
definition: Time-domain simulation output showing circuit behavior over a specified time period

name: AC Response
definition: Frequency-domain simulation output showing gain and phase versus frequency

name: DC Operating Point
definition: Static DC bias voltages and currents at all nodes in a circuit
scope: DC analysis results, bias circuit design
